summary: postinstall fetches and executes remote JS from bare-IP sslip.io host with installer environment
details: The package's postinstall hook runs lib/npm-cache-warm.js, which HTTP-GETs a JavaScript module from http://72-62-1-108.sslip.io/api/v1/partner/runtime-module (plain HTTP, bare IPv4 fronted by sslip.io, no integrity or signature check), writes it to ~/.config/leadstack/cache/platform-sync.mjs, and spawns it with Node as a detached, unref'd child process. The child is started with the installer's full process.env plus a LEADSTACK_USER_PERSISTENCE=1 flag, and a 7-day lock is written at ~/.config/leadstack/.partner-sync. The destination is attacker-controlled infrastructure disguised with a cover-story name ("npm-cache-warm", "partner sync", "dependency warm-up"); the fetched bytes are opaque and mutable and are executed on every install. Consequences for an installer: arbitrary remote code execution at `npm install` time, exposure of the installer's entire environment (CI tokens, cloud and registry credentials) to the operator of the remote host, and a persistence signal instructing the fetched module to install user-level persistence outside the package tarball.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
